title: Nuclear Age
purpose: Operate monitored high-output nuclear power suitable for orbital development.
optimization_opportunities: Efficient layouts improve fuel use and output; automation reduces downtime and accelerates launch manufacturing.
infrastructure_reuse: Heavy-industry materials, programmable monitoring, and existing power distribution become the space-program utility grid.

milestones.title: IC2 Nuclear Reactor
final_validation: Build a complete IC2 nuclear reactor and safe support area.

milestones.title: Sustained Nuclear Output
final_validation: Produce useful sustained power with a stable reactor design.

milestones.title: Reactor Telemetry
final_validation: Monitor heat, output, and operating state.

milestones.title: Remote Emergency Shutdown
final_validation: Trigger a remote shutdown and watch reactor output fall to zero.

milestones.title: Nuclear Containment
final_validation: Use MFFS or equivalent containment appropriate to the reactor risk.

milestones.title: Monitored Nuclear Power
final_validation: Operate stable, monitored high-output nuclear infrastructure for advanced manufacturing.
